summary: The proposed patch appears to address the issue of offset dash linestyle having no effect in patch objects, but it introduces a behavioral regression risk and lacks documentation/comment updates.

issues.description: The patch removes the dashoffset handling, which may break existing/untested behavior.
There are no tests added to cover the change.
The patch does not include documentation/comment updates to explain the change.
The patch may be overfitting to the specific test case, rather than addressing the general issue.
